Auto parts delivery in Columbia and the Midlands

A car on the lift waiting on a part is money lost. We run parts between stores, warehouses, dealerships and repair shops across the Midlands, so your techs stay working instead of driving.

For shops, dealers and parts stores

Independent repair shops, body shops, dealerships, parts stores and mobile mechanics use us for same-day parts runs, store-to-store transfers and returns. Book online in a minute and track every run from your phone.

The right vehicle for the part

A car for small parts and boxes, a minivan for several boxes, and a pickup truck for bulky items like bumpers, wheels and exhaust parts. No single piece over 75 lbs.

How it works

  1. 1. Get your price

    Enter the pickup and delivery addresses for an instant quote. No calling around.

  2. 2. Book in minutes

    Choose standard or Rush and a car, minivan or pickup truck, then pay securely online.

  3. 3. Track it live

    Follow the driver on the map. Delivery is confirmed with a photo, signature and GPS location.

Questions

Can you pick up from a parts store and bring it to my shop?

Yes. Put the store as the pickup and your shop as the drop-off. With Rush, it goes to the front of the line.

Do you offer business accounts?

Yes. Shops that book often can set up a business account and add their team. Contact us and we'll get you set up.
